planets.name: WASP-64 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Atakoraka with a 1.57-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-64 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Atakoraka. Its orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GILLON_ET_AL__2013): disc_year 2012, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.573290273, pl_radj 1.271, pl_bmassj 1.271

quotes.title: WASP-64
quotes.card: It is a G7 class main-sequence star, orbited by a planet WASP-64b.
quotes.introduction: It is younger than the Sun at 3.6±1.6 billion years, and it has a metal abundance similar to the Sun.
